info.title: Unsora API
info.description: Public API for Unsora integrations. Use Bearer token from Clerk in Authorization header.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: Every video, image and motion-control model, with each model's inputs taken from the provider's own request schema and prices quoted live. One generate endpoint covers all of them.

url.description: Public URL of the stored file.

CatalogField.description: One input of a model endpoint. `key` is the provider's own field name; send it in `inputs` with that name.

options.description: Allowed values (select, aspect, duration, toggle). A value of "auto" means: leave the field out.

media.description: Media fields only: file kind and how many URLs it takes (1 = a single URL string).

legacyDbModels.description: Older model names that also resolve to this model.

endpoints.description: Provider endpoints behind the mode. The first one whose `when` media fields all have files is used; the last is the fallback.

model.description: Model key from GET /catalog (older names such as `veo` or `kling-pro` also work).

category.description: Optional guard: reject the request if the model is from another category.

mode.description: Mode key from GET /catalog. Omit to pick it from the attached media.

inputs.description: Inputs in the provider's field names, as listed by GET /catalog. Media fields take URLs; files hosted outside Unsora are imported into your library first. Omitted fields use the model's defaults.

example.prompt: A red fox running through fresh snow at sunrise

expectedCredits.description: The most credits you agree to spend (e.g. the quote's `credits`). If the live price is higher, nothing is charged and the API answers 409 PRICE_CHANGED.

credits.description: Credits one run costs. Null when the model can't be priced until its required files are attached.

modelId.description: Provider endpoint the request routes to.

estimate.description: True while required files are missing, so the final price may differ.

model.description: Any video model key from GET /catalog (e.g. `seedance-2.5`, `veo-3.1-fast`, `kling-o3-pro`). Older names still work: `kling-standard`, `kling-pro`, `veo`, `veo-fast`, `veo-lite`, `sora-2`, `sora-2-pro`, `seedance-2.0(-fast|-mini)`, `gemini-omni-flash`; `wan` maps to Wan 3.0.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio. Valid values depend on the model.

negativePrompt.description: Not supported by Sora models or Seedance.

resolution.description: Output resolution (e.g. 720p, 1080p) for models that offer it; see GET /catalog.

sound.description: Generate audio, for models that offer it. Omitted: the model's default.

image.description: Start image for image-to-video. For Seedance this triggers first/last-frame mode.

lastImage.description: End/last image, for models that support start/end frames.

referenceImages.description: Reference image URLs (Veo 3.1 reference mode; Seedance omni reference, up to 9; Gemini Omni Flash reference-to-video, up to 4).

referenceVideos.description: Seedance omni reference only — up to 3 video URLs.

referenceAudios.description: Seedance omni reference only — up to 3 audio URLs.

lyrics.description: Song lyrics (required for song models, up to 3000 chars)

prompt.description: Style prompt — genre, mood, vocal style (up to 1024 chars)

model.description: Model key: auto, mureka-9, mureka-8, mureka-o2, mureka-7.6, mureka-7.5

previewUrl.description: Short sample clip of the voice

text.description: Script to convert to speech (max 10,000 chars). Supports <#x#> tags between words to pause for x seconds (0.01–99.99).

voice_id.description: Eleven v3 voice id — see GET /voiceovers/voices for descriptions and preview clips

stability.description: Higher = more consistent delivery, lower = more expressive

similarity.description: How closely the output sticks to the base voice

id.description: Connected account id from GET /accounts. Alias: accountId. Each account may appear once per post.

customCaption.description: Caption for this account only. Replaces caption.

title.description: Video title, used by YouTube. Defaults to the first 100 characters of the caption.

PostVideoMediaInput.description: One video. Creates a VIDEO post.

url.description: Public URL of the video file, for example the `url` returned by POST /uploads.

cover_url.description: Cover image URL. Added to the post as its THUMBNAIL media item and used as the Instagram Reel cover. Alias: coverUrl. Takes precedence over settings.instagram.cover_url.

duration_sec.description: Duration in seconds. Aliases: duration_seconds, duration, durationSec, video_duration_sec.

bytes.description: File size in bytes. Alias: size.

mime_type.description: MIME type, e.g. video/mp4. Aliases: mime, mimeType.

metadata.description: Optional. May carry the duration, size and MIME type fields instead of the top level.

PostSlideshowMediaInput.description: Images for a carousel or photo post. Creates a CAROUSEL post.

PostMediaItemInput.description: One media item in the array form of `media`.

type.description: THUMBNAIL is a video cover image (used as the Instagram Reel cover).

order.description: Display order. Defaults to the array index.

cover_url.description: Reel cover image URL for VIDEO posts. Alias: coverUrl. The image is added to the post as its THUMBNAIL media item. Ignored when the video already has a cover (media.cover_url or a THUMBNAIL item). Without a cover, Instagram uses the frame at 5 seconds.

TikTokPostSettings.description: Options applied to TikTok accounts. The camelCase spelling of each key is also accepted (e.g. privacyLevel). Values of the wrong type are rejected with 400.

privacy_level.description: Who can view the post: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR or SELF_ONLY. Must be an option TikTok allows for the creator account.

brand_content_toggle.description: Discloses a paid partnership promoting a third-party brand. Sent only when set.

brand_organic_toggle.description: Discloses that the post promotes the creator's own business. Sent only when set.

is_aigc.description: Labels the post as AI-generated content. Sent only when set.

auto_add_music.description: Photo posts only. Lets TikTok add background music. Sent only when set.

post_mode.description: Photo posts only. DIRECT_POST publishes the post. MEDIA_UPLOAD sends it to the creator's TikTok inbox to finish in the TikTok app.

photo_cover_index.description: Photo posts only. Zero-based index of the cover image, limited to the last image.

video_cover_timestamp_ms.description: Video posts only. Frame used as the cover, in milliseconds from the start.

music_usage_confirmation.description: Stored with the account settings. Not sent to TikTok.

YouTubePostSettings.description: Options applied to YouTube accounts (provider google). snake_case spellings are also accepted: privacy_status, category_id, made_for_kids.

tags.description: Video tags. Each tag must be a non-empty string.

categoryId.description: YouTube video category id. 22 is People & Blogs.

boardId.description: Board to pin to. Alias: board_id. Defaults to the account's first board. List boards with GET /accounts/{accountId}/pinterest/boards.

title.description: Pin title. Defaults to the start of the caption.

link.description: Destination link (http or https) opened when the pin is clicked.

GoogleBusinessPostSettings.description: Options applied to Google Business Profile locations: an optional call-to-action button on the post.

cta_type.description: Button shown on the post. Alias: ctaType. CALL dials the location's phone number.

cta_url.description: Link (http or https) the button opens. Alias: ctaUrl. Required for every cta_type except CALL; must be omitted for CALL.

PostPlatformSettings.description: Per-platform options. Each account receives only the options for its own platform; accounts on other platforms ignore them. Any other key is rejected with 400.

caption.description: Post text, used for every account that has no customCaption. Must not be empty. Alias: mainCaption.

accounts.description: Accounts to publish to. Platforms can be mixed. Every account must belong to the caller.

media.description: Omit or send null for a text post. Send a video object, a slideshow object, or an array of media items.

type.description: Overrides the post type inferred from media. Inferred type: no media is TEXT; a video object is VIDEO; a slideshow object is CAROUSEL; an array is CAROUSEL when it has more than one item, VIDEO when its single item is a VIDEO, otherwise IMAGE.

scheduled_at.description: When to publish, as an ISO 8601 date-time with a UTC offset (Unix time in milliseconds is also accepted). Must be at least 2 minutes in the future. Omit, or send null or an empty string, to save a draft. Alias: scheduledFor.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Stored with the schedule for display; it does not change how scheduled_at is read.

instagram.description: Same as settings.instagram. Ignored when settings.instagram is present.

tiktok.description: Same as settings.tiktok. Ignored when settings.tiktok is present.

youtube.description: Same as settings.youtube. Ignored when settings.youtube is present.

pinterest.description: Same as settings.pinterest. Ignored when settings.pinterest is present.

google_business.description: Same as settings.google_business. Ignored when settings.google_business is present.

external_id.description: Your own identifier for this request. With an API key and no Idempotency-Key header, its first 128 characters are used as the idempotency key. Not stored on the post.

PostSummary.description: Short form of a post returned by POST /posts. Uses lowercase values; GET /posts/{id} returns the full record.

type.description: CAROUSEL posts are reported as slideshow.

fileSize.description: Size in bytes, serialized as a string.

PostAccount.description: One account a post targets, with its publish result.

settings.description: Platform options stored for this account (the matching entry of PostPlatformSettings).

publishedUrl.description: Public URL of the post on the platform.

error.description: Error from the last publish attempt for this account.

provider.description: google (YouTube), tiktok, instagram, facebook, threads, bluesky, pinterest, linkedin, x or google_business (one account per Business Profile location).

status.description: PUBLISHED: every account published. PARTIALLY_PUBLISHED: at least one account published and at least one failed. FAILED: no account published.

error.description: Summary of the last publishing failure.

source.description: Where the post was created: the web app, the REST API, or the Unsora MCP server (requests with header X-Unsora-Client: mcp).

apiKeyId.description: API key used to create the post. Null when it was created with a Clerk session or OAuth token.

mainCaption.description: New caption. Must not be empty.

scheduledFor.description: A date (ISO 8601 or Unix time in milliseconds) moves the post to SCHEDULED. null or an empty string clears the schedule; a SCHEDULED post returns to DRAFT.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name stored with the schedule. Read only when scheduledFor is a date. Clearing the schedule also clears the time zone.

accounts.description: Replaces the account list. Accounts that already published are kept unchanged. Listed accounts are updated or added, and unpublished accounts that are not listed are removed. Existing accounts keep their platform settings; added accounts have none.

results.description: Always empty. Per-account results are on the post (GET /posts/{id}).

PostMetrics.description: Cumulative counters. Metrics a platform does not expose are 0 (e.g. Bluesky views, TikTok saves, YouTube shares and saves). Facebook and LinkedIn likes count every reaction type. Pinterest views are impressions and shares are outbound clicks. X shares are reposts plus quotes and saves are bookmarks. Google Business Profile reports search views only.

postCount.description: Number of per-account posts published in the window.

timeseries.description: One point per day from the start of the window to today. Each point sums every post's latest snapshot taken before the end of that day, so values are totals to date, not daily increments.

posts.description: One entry per account a post was published to, newest first.

caption.description: The account's customCaption, or the post caption.

lastFetchedAt.description: Time of the latest snapshot. Null when metrics have not been fetched yet; metrics are then 0.

refreshed.description: Number of per-account posts that received a new metrics snapshot.

get.summary: List generation models with their inputs
get.description: Every video, image and motion-control model, its modes, and each endpoint's input fields (names, allowed values, ranges, defaults). Prices aren't listed because they depend on the inputs; use POST /catalog/quote.

post.description: Live credit price for one run with these exact inputs (resolution, duration, audio, and the length of attached video or audio). Free; nothing is charged.

post.summary: Start a video, image or motion-control generation
post.description: Validates the inputs against the model, prices the run live, charges the credits and queues it. Poll GET /video/status/{id} (video and motion control) or GET /image/status/{id} (image). Supports the Idempotency-Key header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retrying with the same key replays the first response instead of charging again.

400.description: Invalid model, mode or inputs, or a media file couldn't be read

409.description: The live price is above `expectedCredits`; nothing was charged (code PRICE_CHANGED, `credits` holds the new price)

post.description: Kept for existing integrations. Takes the fields below, translates them onto the chosen model, and runs through POST /catalog/generate with the same live pricing. New integrations should use /catalog/generate, which exposes every model input.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Filter by video model key (e.g. seedance-2.0, veo, kling-pro).

get.summary: Poll image / influencer / thumbnail generation status

post.description: Kept for existing integrations. Takes the fields below, translates them onto the chosen model, and runs through POST /catalog/generate with the same live pricing. New integrations should use /catalog/generate, which exposes every model input.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Max 128 chars. Replays the same response for 24h on API key requests.

model.description: Any image model key from GET /catalog (e.g. `nano-banana-2`, `nano-banana-pro`, `gpt-image-2`, `seedream-5.0-pro`). `gpt-image-1.5` maps to GPT Image 2 and `seedream-v5-lite` to Seedream 5.0 Pro.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio. Valid values depend on the model; `auto` uses the model's default.

resolution.description: Output size such as `1k`, `2k` or `4k`, for models that offer it. Other values fall back to the model's default.

quality.description: Quality tier, for models that offer it.

referenceImages.description: Public HTTPS reference image URLs. The maximum count depends on the model.

get.summary: List Eleven v3 voices with preview clips
get.description: Returns the 20 ElevenLabs Eleven v3 voices available for voiceover generation. Each voice includes a short previewUrl clip so users can pick a voice by ear.

post.summary: Create a script-to-voiceover job (ElevenLabs Eleven v3)
post.description: Converts a script (max 10,000 chars) into natural speech using ElevenLabs Eleven v3. Costs 6 credits per started 1,000 characters. Output is always mp3. Poll /voiceovers/status/{id} for the result.

post.summary: Create a Mureka AI music generation job

post.description: Each image in `count` is a separate generation and credit charge. Poll each id with GET /image/status/{id}.

prompt.description: Describe the influencer scene, outfit, mood, or action.

post.description: Generates 16:9 thumbnails. Send at least one of `prompt`, `context`, or reference images. Each variation is a separate generation and credit charge (12 credits each).

prompt.description: Title or idea for the thumbnail.

context.description: One source for the thumbnail: a YouTube video (`youtube`, reads its title and transcript) or a PDF (`document`, public URL).

referenceImageUrls.description: Reference images, such as the creator's face. Up to 16 including the template.

templateImageUrls.description: One layout template image to follow.

expression.description: Facial expression for the person in the thumbnail.

post.description: Finds the best moments in a long video and cuts them into short clips. Credits depend on the source video's length. Poll GET /clippings/status/{clippingId} until the job finishes.

videoUrl.description: Public video URL, such as a YouTube link.

query.description: Describe the moments to find, e.g. `funny reactions`.

captionStyle.description: Caption preset when `enableCaption` is true, e.g. `classic-yellow`, `bold-white`, `glow-pink`, `gaming-cyan`.

get.summary: Poll clipping job status (syncs with provider when in progress)
Get one clipping job (read-only, no provider sync)

delete.summary: Delete one clip from a clipping job

post.summary: Upload media from a URL or base64 payload
post.description: Imports a file into your media library. Pass either `url` (public http(s) URL, max 200MB — the server fetches the bytes) or `base64` (raw base64 or a data: URL, for small files; the request body is capped at 10MB). The file is stored and recorded as an upload asset; the returned `url` can be used anywhere a media URL is accepted (post media, reference images, clipping input). For large local files use the signed-URL flow: POST /uploads/signed-url, then PUT the bytes, then POST /uploads/complete.

base64.description: Base64 file contents (raw or data: URL). Requires fileName.

fileName.description: Stored file name (required with base64, optional with url).

post.summary: Mint a signed direct-upload URL (large files)
post.description: Mints a short-lived signed URL so the file bytes go directly to storage without passing through the API (use for files too large for POST /uploads). Flow: 1) call this with fileName; 2) PUT the file bytes to `uploadUrl` with the correct Content-Type header; 3) POST /uploads/complete with the returned `blobName` to register the file in your media library.

publicUrl.description: Public URL the file will have after upload.

post.summary: Register a direct-uploaded file as an asset
post.description: Call after PUTting the file bytes to a signed upload URL. Verifies the object exists in storage and records it in your media library. blobName must come from your own /uploads/signed-url response.

delete.description: Deletes the asset record and removes the stored file.

get.description: Returns the social accounts connected to the caller, sorted by account name. Use an account `id` in POST /posts. YouTube accounts have provider `google`.
Boards the connected Pinterest account can pin to: `{ id, name, privacy }`. Pass an `id` as `settings.pinterest.board_id` in POST /posts.

get.summary: Get TikTok posting options for an account
get.description: TikTok's creator info for the account: the privacy levels it may post with (`privacy_level_options`), whether comments, duets and stitches are disabled, the maximum video length and whether it can post right now. Use these values for `settings.tiktok` in POST /posts.

post.summary: Create a scheduled post or draft
post.description: Creates a post for 1 to 10 connected accounts. With `scheduled_at` the post is created as SCHEDULED and published at that time; a scheduler checks for due posts every minute. `scheduled_at` must be at least 2 minutes in the future. Without it the post is saved as a DRAFT, which can be published with POST /posts/{id}/publish. Per-platform options go in `settings` (or in top-level `instagram`, `tiktok`, `youtube`, `pinterest` and `google_business` objects); each account receives only the options for its own platform. Media, post type and account platforms are not cross-checked here. POST /posts/{id}/publish and /retry check them before starting; a scheduled post is published without that check and failures are recorded per account. Idempotency applies only to requests authenticated with an API key: send an `Idempotency-Key` header, or `external_id` in the body when the header is absent. The first 201 response is stored for 24 hours and returned again for the same key with header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. The request body is not compared. Reusing a key with a different method or path returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Requests made with a Clerk session or OAuth token are not deduplicated. The post records `source` API, or MCP when the request has header `X-Unsora-Client: mcp`, and the id of the API key used (`apiKeyId`). Requires an active paid plan.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Idempotency key, up to 128 characters. Used only with API keys. Longer keys are ignored.

parameters.name: X-Unsora-Client
parameters.description: The Unsora MCP server sends `mcp`, which records the post source as MCP. Any other value, or no header, records API.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present with value true when the response is a stored replay for a repeated idempotency key.

400.description: Invalid request body. `error` describes the first problem found (for example a missing caption, more than 10 accounts, scheduled_at less than 2 minutes ahead, or an unsupported settings key).

403.description: PLAN_REQUIRED: no active paid plan. UNKNOWN_ACCOUNTS: one or more accounts do not belong to the caller.

409.description: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: the idempotency key was already used with a different method or path.

get.description: Returns the caller's posts as full post records, newest first by creation time.

400.description: Invalid status, type, page or limit. Out-of-range values are rejected, not clamped.

get.description: Aggregates engagement metrics for posts published in the last `days` days, counted per account. Each post contributes its latest stored metrics snapshot. Snapshots are polled from the platforms every 6 hours for posts published in the last 90 days, and on demand with POST /posts/analytics/refresh.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Window in days. Values outside 7–90 are clamped.

post.summary: Refresh post metrics from the platforms
post.description: Polls the platforms for current metrics of the caller's posts published in the last 90 days (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Bluesky, X, Google Business Profile) and stores a snapshot for each. The response is returned after polling finishes. Accounts whose platform request fails are skipped. Call GET /posts/analytics/summary afterwards for the updated figures.

get.description: Returns the full post record. After publish or retry, poll this until `status` is PUBLISHED, PARTIALLY_PUBLISHED or FAILED. Per-account results are in `postAccounts` (`published`, `publishedUrl`, `error`).

put.description: Updates the caption, schedule or accounts of a post that is not PUBLISHED. Only the fields sent are changed. Media, post type and platform settings can't be changed here. The 2-minute minimum lead time of POST /posts is not enforced; a time in the past is picked up by the next scheduler run. Requires an active paid plan.

400.description: Invalid field, or the post is PUBLISHED and can't be edited.

403.description: PLAN_REQUIRED: no active paid plan. Also returned without a code when an account does not belong to the caller.

409.description: The post is PUBLISHING. Try again after it finishes.

delete.description: Deletes the post and its per-account records. Content already published on a platform is not removed from that platform. Requires an active paid plan.

409.description: The post is PUBLISHING. Try again after it finishes.

post.description: Starts publishing to every account on the post that has not published yet and returns 202 right away with status PUBLISHING. Publishing runs in the background; poll GET /posts/{id} until `status` is PUBLISHED, PARTIALLY_PUBLISHED or FAILED. Accepts DRAFT, SCHEDULED, FAILED and PARTIALLY_PUBLISHED posts. Before starting, the post is checked. It needs at least one account. VIDEO needs exactly one video, IMAGE exactly one image, CAROUSEL at least one image, and TEXT no media and a non-empty caption; video and images can't be mixed (THUMBNAIL items are not counted). The platform of every unpublished account must support the post type: YouTube supports VIDEO; TikTok, Instagram and Pinterest support VIDEO, IMAGE and CAROUSEL; Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn and X support all four types; Google Business Profile supports IMAGE and TEXT. Requires an active paid plan.

400.description: The post can't be published. `code` is POST_PUBLISHED (the post, or every account on it, is already published), ACCOUNT_REQUIRED, MEDIA_REQUIRED, MEDIA_NOT_ALLOWED, MIXED_MEDIA, CAPTION_REQUIRED or UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.

409.description: POST_PUBLISHING: the post is already publishing.

post.summary: Retry the failed accounts of a post
post.description: Publishes again to the accounts that have not published on a FAILED or PARTIALLY_PUBLISHED post. Accounts that already published are not posted again. Runs the same checks as POST /posts/{id}/publish and returns 202 with status PUBLISHING; poll GET /posts/{id} for the outcome. Requires an active paid plan.

400.description: The post can't be retried. `code` is NOT_RETRYABLE (the post is DRAFT or SCHEDULED), POST_PUBLISHED, ACCOUNT_REQUIRED, MEDIA_REQUIRED, MEDIA_NOT_ALLOWED, MIXED_MEDIA, CAPTION_REQUIRED or UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.

409.description: POST_PUBLISHING: the post is already publishing.
